hero.title: National Business Register of Astoria
hero.lead: The RNEA is the official source of information on Astorian businesses: identity, directors, formalities and legal documents.

consult.title: Search the RNEA
consult.lead: Query the national register like a registry office would: a business, an RNEA number, an establishment or a director.
consult.note: Information on directors is available where the law makes it public.

rneaNumber.desc: Reach a business directly through its unique identifier.

understand.title: Understand the RNEA
understand.lead: The register centralises and publishes the legal information of businesses to secure Astoria's economic life.

what.title: The official register
what.desc: The RNEA is the single national register of businesses incorporated in Astoria.

role.title: An economic role
role.desc: It guarantees the identity of businesses and secures exchanges between business partners.

centralizes.desc: Registrations, amendments, cessations and legal documents are brought together in one place.

manage.title: Manage your business

meta.title: Accessibility statement
meta.description: The accessibility statement of the National Business Register of Astoria.

hero.title: Accessibility statement
hero.lead: The National Business Register of Astoria is committed to making its portal accessible to everyone.
hero.notice: This accessibility statement applies to the rnea.gouv.aor portal.

declaration.title: Statement of commitment
declaration.lead: The RNEA is committed to making its portal accessible, in accordance with Astorian digital accessibility regulations.

paragraphs.p1: This statement describes the compliance status of the portal with the general accessibility framework, the non-accessible content and how to report a problem.
paragraphs.p2: The register's management ensures that every new version of the portal maintains and improves its accessibility level.

conformite.title: Compliance status
conformite.lead: The portal is partially compliant with the applicable framework.

bullets.b1: Colour contrasts meet the recommended thresholds across all pages.
bullets.b2: Keyboard navigation covers menus, search and forms.
bullets.b3: Text content has textual alternatives where necessary.

nonAccessibles.title: Non-accessible content
nonAccessibles.lead: Despite our vigilance, some content may have accessibility limitations.

bullets.b1: Some scanned documents filed with the register may not be fully accessible.
bullets.b2: Advanced statistical charts may require an alternative reading.
bullets.b3: Content published before this statement may not fully comply with the framework.

etablissement.title: Establishment of this statement
etablissement.lead: This statement was established on 1 September 2026.

tests.label: Tests carried out
tests.value: Checks performed on the main pages of the portal.

retour.title: Feedback and contact
retour.lead: If you cannot access a content or a service, you can report it to us.

paragraphs.p1: Write to us through the contact page of the portal or by post to the address of the National Business Register. You will receive a response as soon as possible.

voiesRecours.title: Recourse procedures
voiesRecours.lead: If you consider that your request has not been dealt with, the following recourses are available.

bullets.b1: Write to the Astorian public services ombudsman.
bullets.b2: Contact the authority in charge of the defence of rights.
bullets.b3: Contact the competent administrative authority as a last resort.

meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: The privacy policy of the National Business Register of Astoria: data collected, purposes and rights.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.lead: The RNEA processes your personal data in accordance with Astorian data protection regulations.
hero.notice: This policy applies to the rnea.gouv.aor portal.

responsable.title: Data controller
responsable.lead: The processing of personal data is the responsibility of the National Business Register of Astoria.

paragraphs.p1: The data controller ensures that your data is collected and used lawfully, fairly and transparently.

donnees.title: Data collected
donnees.lead: The portal only collects the data required to run its services.

bullets.b1: The data you enter in the contact and subscription forms.
bullets.b2: Connection data (IP address, log) to secure the service.
bullets.b3: Anonymised audience measurement data to improve the portal.
bullets.b4: No personal data is collected during a simple consultation of the register.

finalites.title: Purposes and legal bases
finalites.lead: Each processing serves a specific purpose and is based on a legal ground.

paragraphs.p1: Data is processed to answer your requests, secure the portal and measure its audience.
paragraphs.p2: The processing is based on the performance of public service missions and, for audience measurement, on your consent.

conservation.title: Retention period
conservation.lead: Data is only kept for as long as needed for the purpose of the processing.

duree.label: Duration
duree.value: In accordance with the applicable legal retention periods.

critere.label: Criterion
critere.value: The purpose of the processing and the legal obligations.

droits.title: Your rights
droits.lead: You have rights over your personal data.

bullets.b1: The right of access to your data.
bullets.b2: The right to rectify inaccurate data.
bullets.b3: The right to object, under certain conditions.
bullets.b4: The right to erasure, in the cases provided for by law.
bullets.b5: The right to withdraw your consent for audience measurement.

cookies.title: Cookies and audience measurement
cookies.lead: The portal sets audience measurement cookies, subject to your consent.

paragraphs.p1: You can configure your consent at any time from the cookie management page.

cookies.notice: No advertising cookie is set by the portal.

meta.title: Cookie management
meta.description: The cookie policy of the National Business Register of Astoria: cookie families used and how to manage them.

hero.title: Cookie management
hero.lead: The portal sets audience measurement cookies to understand its usage and improve its services.
hero.notice: Your choices are kept for six months.

definition.title: What is a cookie?
definition.lead: A cookie is a small file stored on your device when you visit a website.

paragraphs.p1: It allows your browser to be recognised and certain information to be remembered for the duration of your visit or for later visits.
paragraphs.p2: Some cookies are essential for the website to work, others require your consent.

cookiesDeposes.title: Cookies set
cookiesDeposes.lead: The portal sets the following cookie families.

table.caption: Cookie families set by the portal

3.1: Protecting the portal against abusive use

table.note: No advertising cookie is set by the portal.

gestion.title: Cookie management
gestion.lead: You can configure the use of cookies at any time.

bullets.b1: From the consent banner displayed on your first visit.
bullets.b2: By configuring your browser to refuse or limit cookies.
bullets.b3: By contacting the register's data protection officer.

gestion.notice: Refusing audience measurement cookies does not affect the operation of the portal.

meta.title: Terms of use
meta.description: The terms of use of the National Business Register of Astoria portal.

hero.title: Terms of use
hero.lead: This document defines the terms of use of the rnea.gouv.aor portal.
hero.notice: These terms apply to all content and services of the portal.

objet.title: Purpose of the portal
objet.lead: The portal aims to facilitate access to the information and services of the register.

paragraphs.p1: It provides information on businesses, formalities, official documents and public data of the register.
paragraphs.p2: Published information is indicative only and does not hold the register liable in case of inappropriate commercial use.

utilisation.title: Using the portal
utilisation.lead: The portal is freely accessible to any natural or legal person.

bullets.b1: Using the portal is free of charge for public consultation.
bullets.b2: Published data may be reused in accordance with the applicable licence.
bullets.b3: It is forbidden to use the portal to access information fraudulently.
bullets.b4: Accounts and personal spaces are strictly personal and non-transferable.

contenus.title: Content and data
contenus.lead: The content of the portal is provided with the greatest care.

paragraphs.p1: The register data comes from official sources and is updated regularly.
paragraphs.p2: If you notice an error, you can report it so that it can be corrected as soon as possible.

responsabilite.title: Liability
responsabilite.lead: The register strives to ensure the availability and accuracy of the information.

paragraphs.p1: The register cannot be held liable for a temporary unavailability of the portal or for any use of the information contrary to its purpose.
paragraphs.p2: The user is responsible for the use they make of the information from the portal.

liens.title: External links
liens.lead: The portal may provide links to other Astorian public services.

paragraphs.p1: The register has no control over the content of these services and declines all responsibility towards them.

modification.title: Modification of the terms
modification.lead: These terms may evolve to reflect changes in the service.

paragraphs.p1: Any modification takes effect on the date of its publication on the portal.
